title: yaks kernel keyword vocabulary
description: Three keywords a graph of work needs that the core meta-model does not define: which components a project answers for, which components stay out of the snapshot a client loads at startup, and where a text column's suggested values come from.

governed.description: true = a project answers for the entities carrying this component, reached by edges rooted at the project. It is what a project's reach is computed over.

lazy.description: true = this component's rows are left out of the snapshot a client loads at startup; a reader asks for them by the partition they belong to.

well.description: Names a list of suggested values for this text column, offered for completion beside the values already in the column. The list is registered by whoever holds the values, so the schema stays declarative.
